objective: Trong simple chance contexts, dùng impossible/possible/certain và more/less/equally likely như qualitative comparisons trước khi gán số; khi một finite probability model được nêu rõ, nối các comparisons đó với probability scale 0-to-1 mà không giả vờ qualitative ordering đã xác định một numerical probability duy nhất.

external_curriculum_mappings.phase: KS2-KS3 probability language, likelihood and probability scale
early chance language, ordering likelihood and probability

misconceptions_or_representation_notes: Saying one event is more likely does not by itself specify how much more likely.
Qualitative comparisons depend on the stated context/information; a later probability model may sharpen or revise them.
Probability 0/1 language in continuous models requires later formal care; this objective bridges to finite elementary models only.
change_reason: Added direct sourced support for pre-numerical qualitative chance language required by F13-G08, then preserved the transition to finite-model 0-to-1 probability.
